summary: Befale territory (Tshuapa province) lies in the central Congo basin, far from the eastern conflict zones, and no armed group is known to hold or operate in it. Befale town, the territory headquarters, is administered by the state with the PNC as the main day-to-day security force. Rural villages of the Befale and Mompono secteurs have thin state presence (scattered police posts) and rely heavily on customary authorities, but no non-state armed actor is reported to exercise control. Web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for Befale town and low for rural villages.

zones.description: Befale town (territory chef-lieu; Inkeke/Centre Commercial Befale, Befale health area)
zones.evidence: Territory headquarters with territorial administration, PNC commissariat and courts of peace; no armed group known to operate in Tshuapa. No web sources could be retrieved in this run (web search budget exhausted), so the assessment rests on the absence of known armed-group activity in Befale territory and Tshuapa province.

zones.description: Rural villages of Befale secteur (Befale health zone: Baringa, Ekafera, Boonia, Bokoli, Lomako, Lolengi areas; and Befale-secteur villages in Mompono/Boende HZ: Iyali, Djombo, Ekukola Bolongo, Imbo)
zones.evidence: Remote forest/river villages (including near the Lomako-Yokokala reserve) with no known armed-group presence; order rests on scattered PNC posts and customary chiefs under state administration. No web sources could be retrieved in this run (web search budget exhausted), so the assessment rests on the absence of known armed-group activity in Befale territory and Tshuapa province.
